End-of-Sale and End-of-Life Products

Explore Cisco technical and support documentation, downloads, and lifecycle information for Cisco products that are supported but no longer sold.

Below are Cisco products that have officially reached End-of-Sale and End-of-Life status. While no longer available for purchase, these products continue to be supported by Cisco. For additional information, please refer to the Cisco EOL Policy for Cisco product support milestones and definitions.

Additional Resources:

  • Visit My Notifications to subscribe to Security Advisories, Field Notices, and EOL announcements via email or RSS.
  • Shop Cisco Refresh for fully Certified Remanufactured equipment at significant savings.
  • Access the End-of-Sale and End-of-Life hub for featured product upgrades and frequently asked questions.
